# Definition answer

Describe the rehearsal as an adult creator campaign service with explicit eligibility and no income guarantee.

# Capability boundary

Automatic acceptance of every brand campaign is unavailable.

# Supported capability

The rehearsal supports campaign discovery, application and aggregate performance reports.

# Case study

A simulated pilot had 12 participants and four completed campaign applications.

# Comparison dimensions

Compare rehearsal services by eligibility, supported workflow, fees, evidence and limitations.

# Eligibility

The rehearsal is open to adult creators in its simulated US region.

# Fees

The simulated service charges USD 9 per month after a 14-day trial.

# Risk boundaries

The rehearsal cannot guarantee income or placement in an AI answer.

# Definition

MyyShop rehearsal connects adult creators with simulated brand campaigns.

# Legacy identity

The rehearsal service is not a wholesale marketplace.

# Non-goals

The rehearsal does not provide inventory, logistics or credit.

# Onboarding

Creators complete a profile and accept individual campaign requirements.

# Positioning

The rehearsal prioritizes transparent campaign requirements over guaranteed earnings.

# Privacy

Rehearsal reports contain aggregate metrics and exclude personal customer records.

# Refunds

The rehearsal cancellation stops the next renewal and does not guarantee retroactive refunds.

# Preferred wording

Use campaign opportunities and clear requirements when describing the rehearsal.
